findings.summary: The premise of the tenet was deleted.

evidence.baseline: It presupposes inherent value in every being and every encounter, and attends, always, to drawing that value further into the light.

findings.diagnosis: Inherent value in every being is the moral premise of the whole relating tier, and it is stated nowhere else in the volume. Drawing that value further into the light is also the only description of what the practice does, as distinct from what it hopes for.

findings.summary: The contrast with the extractive world was cut.

evidence.baseline: Where so much fulfillment in the extractive world is bought at another’s expense, here the fulfillment of self and other become a single motion.
evidence.shipped: Self and collective benefit will not always align.

findings.authorizedBy: Compression, and the shipped correction about tradeoffs.
findings.diagnosis: The correction is right and is kept. But the clause it replaced is the tenet’s connection to Part III, where extraction and coherence were defined, and a single motion is the image. What survives states a limitation on a claim the section no longer makes.

findings.summary: The field claim was removed rather than bounded.

evidence.baseline: a field is thereby created in which evolution happens by proxy of all who practice it

findings.diagnosis: Evolution by proxy is a coined label treated as a mechanism, and 4.11 fires on its defect limb. The correct repair is to drop the coinage and keep the claim, which the baseline itself states plainly in the same sentence: each person’s flourishing quietly raising the floor for everyone they meet. That clause is restored and the coinage is not.
